messages:
Alex P: Quick sync — need to lock Q3 roadmap priorities for Private deployments. Big asks from two customers: full VPC control plane + on-prem installer and an airtight air-gapped packaging option. Thoughts on minimal launch set?
Maya E: Can we define 'airtight'? customers expect zero internet egress during install, plus KMS integration on day 1. :thinking:
Chris I: From infra POV, VPC control plane + private workers is doable. Biggest risk is upgrades in air-gapped envs — need offline bundle + checksum updates. Also we need an OS-level prereq matrix.
Sara S: Compliance asked for HSM/KMS + audit logs retention 1yr. We need to surface key rotation UX in scope.
Li W: Sales says these two customers will only move if we give: SLA 99.9% uptime for control plane + formal install runbook and SOW. They're willing to sign Dedicated if we commit.
Alex P: Proposed minimal launch: 1) VPC control plane (customer-managed VPC peering or private link) 2) On-prem bundle w/ offline installer + signed artifacts 3) KMS integration (bring-your-own) 4) Rollout docs + runbook. Exclude full auto-upgrades for MVP. Agree?
Maya E: +1 on excluding auto-upgrades. But we should include a documented upgrade path (manual) and a patching checklist.
Chris I: Implementation notes: offline bundle size ~500MB compressed for core runtime, plus separate model artifacts. Need checksums and signed manifests. Suggest using tgz + cosign signatures.
Sara S: Add: forensic logs must be exportable to SIEM; include a sample Logstash/Fluent config in MVP artifacts.
Li W: Customers will push back if we don't provide install support as part of contract. Can we include 10 days of onboarding in enterprise SOW?
Alex P: Yes, include onboarding add-on. Also need acceptance criteria: - Control plane reachable within customer's VPC - Offline installer completes on a baseline Ubuntu 20.04 or RHEL 8 host - KMS key operations verified in a test run - Audit logs present for 24h after install
Maya E: Any thoughts on packaging formats? rpm/deb + docker tar? Or single binary + systemd unit?
Chris I: For MVP: provide deb/rpm for package managers + docker image for runtime. For air-gap, provide container tarball + local registry instructions.
Alex P: Timeline check: If eng delivers control plane + installer + KMS in 8 weeks, docs + runbook in 2 => total 10 wks. Is that realistic?
Chris I: 8 weeks is tight but doable if we freeze scope now. Need two engineers + one infra oncall.
Sara S: Security review window: reserve 2 weeks mid-dev for threat model + pentest triage.
Li W: Market ask: we should flag this as 'sales-priority' in roadmap so legal and pricing know to expect SOWs.
Deploy Bot: Created task INF-8932: "Private deploy MVP packaging" — assignees @maya, @chris
Alex P: Action items: 1) Maya to write MVP spec doc + install acceptance tests (due in 3 days) 2) Chris to prototype offline bundle (due 1 week) 3) Sara to draft security checklist (due 1 week) 4) Li to prep SOW template (due 4 days)
Maya E: Ack. I'll start doc and put link here when ready. :eyes:
Chris I: Starting prototype now, I'll post logs if I hit blockers.
Sara S: I'll scope pentest requirements and share with IR team.
Li W: I'll loop legal. Also can we get a short customer-facing one-pager for pilots?
Alex P: Yep — Maya + Li coordinate. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
